summary.text: Russ Goodman, a Republican, has served in the Georgia State Senate since 2020, representing Senate District 8.

paragraphs.text: His legislative biography says Goodman studied agricultural economics at the University of Georgia, lives in Cogdell, and is co-owner of Cogdell Berry Farm.
It says Goodman was president of the Clinch County Farm Bureau and was appointed by Gov. Nathan Deal to the board of the Georgia Development Authority in 2015.
